Peddi Day 4 Worldwide Box Office Collection: Ram Charan Crosses ₹236.45 Crore Worldwide
Ram Charan's Peddi delivered a strong first Sunday performance with an estimated ₹42.65 crore worldwide gross on Day 4. The film collected ₹38.65 crore gross from India and ₹4.00 crore ($420K) from overseas markets on its fourth day. With this performance, Peddi's 4-day worldwide total has climbed to ₹236.45 crore, completing a blockbuster opening weekend and further strengthening the film's box office momentum heading into its crucial weekday run.
